author: GalaxyBen
body:
*Note* I didn't know how or where to post this but I believe it's here.

Username: xBen_

Why was I banned? I was initially banned for Swearing and Profanity but then I was banned for Ban Evading.

Why I should be unbanned? Because I love this server. Ever since I began Minecraft, Avicus has been my first choice of server. The amazing community, staff, gamemodes and new ideas that get put through this server, in my opinion, are truly unique. I was silly to have Ban Evaded and even sillier to have constantly swore in the first place. I will not do it again.

Thank you for taking your time to read this.

Ben

title: Appealing my ban

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello Xben_,

We do not negotiate with ban evaders. This appeal is denied. 

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Senior Moderator
